subject: Ops scorecard alignment — pre-QBR checklist and variance notes
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acmecloud.com, procurement@brightlane.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops scorecard alignment — pre-QBR checklist and variance notes

Team —

Attached is v2 of the June Ops scorecard (spreadsheet). Before the QBR readout next Thursday I want us aligned on a few urgent items:

1) Latency profile (generation)
   - P50: 95ms (target 100ms) — green
   - P95: 1,120ms (target 700ms) — red (spike on 6/21 13:14–13:22 UTC)
   - Note: initial triage shows a small set of customer workloads with long sequences and cache-miss patterns.

2) Cost (hosted)
   - Unit cost: $5.8 per 1M inference tokens (up 12% m/m) — partial driver is increased retry traffic and a billing configuration change for a partner route.

3) Uptime & incidents
   - Platform uptime (30d): 99.92% (below 99.99 SLO) — two short controller restarts on 6/08 and 6/21.

4) Usage trends
   - Active routes up 8% m/m; sustained tail traffic during PST day.

Immediate asks: please read the scorecard and reply with a one-line owner + mitigation by EOD today. I sketched owners in the doc but want confirmations.

Highlights in the attachment: the P95 drill (tab 3) and the cost breakout by route (tab 5). I also included sampled logs from the 6/21 spike (p95-sample-logs-20270621.tar.gz) — those are referenced only, full logs are in the Drive link.

Grace
--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, markus.klein@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ops scorecard alignment — pre-QBR checklist and variance notes

Thanks Grace — quick confirmation and data add.

Owner confirmations:
- Latency P95 triage: jonas_weber (I will lead profiling + KV cache hit analysis).
- Cost breakout by route: tessa_morgan (she has the routing burn-down).
- Controller restarts postmortem: markus_klein (infrastructure).

Preliminary findings (short):
- The 6/21 P95 spike maps to Route: partner-rlf (high sequence lengths + occasional 10x token bursts). Sampled requests show repeated prompt replays from one partner integration — I flagged three session IDs in the logs (see Drive doc).
- A transient slow kernel selection path was observed around 13:16 UTC on the worker group handling that route; appears correlated with a specific GPU revision.

Quick ask for external ops@acmecloud.com: can you confirm whether partner-rlf shipped a config change on 6/21 that would increase sequence lengths or change batching behavior?

Jonas

Agree with the owners. Quick procurement/ops note: the controller restarts on 6/08 and 6/21 were tied to a driver update we rolled to a small pool last month. We delayed rolling to full fleet because of a failing test; looks like a canary group got the update early due to a config mismatch. I'm opening OPS-4123 (linked) and will include a condensed RCA for the QBR.

Procurement cc: Brightlane — the spike on cost for partner-rlf also impacts our committed capacity math; can you confirm whether Brightlane's client billing propagation (the per-route mapping) was updated late May? If billing labels changed, our usage attribution would shift across SKUs and show a temporary unit-cost increase.

Markus

Subject: Re: Ops scorecard alignment — pre-QBR checklist and variance notes

Thanks all — good rapid alignment. Short summary / commitments for the QBR pack: 

1) Latency P95 (owner: jonas_weber) — deliverable: P95 root-cause note + mitigation (KV cache tuning + temporary limit on sequence length for partner-rlf). Target draft by 6/24 10:00 PDT.

2) Cost rotation (owner: tessa_morgan) — deliverable: updated cost-by-route table with corrected billing labels and per-route unit cost; include Brightlane confirmation. Target: 6/24 EOD.

3) Controller restarts RCA (owner: markus_klein) — deliverable: one-page RCA with canary timeline and rollback plan. Target: 6/25 12:00 PDT.

4) QBR slide updates (owner: laura_bennett) — update the executive slide deck with the variance explanation and proposed mitigations. Please keep the slide for P95 to one visual + one-line ask. Target: 6/25 17:00 PDT.

I will consolidate these into the QBR prep doc and circulate the final readout by Friday morning. If external partners (ops@acmecloud.com / procurement@brightlane.com) can confirm the billing/route config items today that will shorten our turnaround.

Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Operations
Redwood Inference
